name: Build iOS App

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: macos-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout Code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Setup Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v3
      with:
        node-version: 18

    - name: Install Dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Sync Capacitor iOS
      run: npx cap sync ios
